$comment: Per-unit defaults for scripts/qa/lesson-v2.mjs as each unit's migration to Lesson structure v3 lands (the teach-first case, approved 27 Sep 2026). A true flag makes that check's warnings breaches for the unit's notes without the command-line flag (teach = --teach-fatal, prompts = --prompts-fatal, withdrawn = --withdrawn-fatal, see = --see-fatal); "list": true prints the unit's per-topic list on every run. FM1 first: the coordinator sets teach, prompts and withdrawn to true once the three FM1 migration authors report (order of 27 Sep 2026); until then the list is printed.
